svg.text: Terraform ≥ 1.9 · hashicorp/aws ~> 5.0 · one file per concern
auth.tf ──JWT authorizer──▶ every route in api_gateway.tf + retrieve_lambda.tf
vector_store.tf ──secret ARN──▶ index + retrieve Lambdas (SECRET_ARN env)
vpc_endpoints.tf ──443 from SGs──▶ index + retrieve reach S3 / Secrets / Bedrock
dlq.tf ──for_each──▶ ingest · embed · index ; observability.tf watches all 5 fns
CI runs terraform fmt -check + validate only — plan/apply are manual. State is local (no remote backend yet).
